page.layout: One column of consular lists, one group per year, with the years in the right margin beside each group. Notes in the left margin beside the lines they stand against. Page number at the head.

l.note: Ius cudēdæ MONETAE AVREAE civitati Groningen datum ab Imp. Friderico III.
Ioan. Tedema videtur aut perperam poni aut mortuus esse in consulatu.

page.notes: The right-margin years 1485–1491 are printed beside their groups. The left-margin note "Foedus cum OSTER-" is broken at the line end; the second half is partly illegible on the scan, so "OSTERLINGIS" is a reading with [?]. The name "Coppen" is printed with a dash-like ligature before "larges"/"Jarges"; transcribed as printed with a space. Some lines are faint and "Berent Horneke" may be imperfect.
